content:
Apple Cash's terms and conditions have been recently updated, and Apple is notifying users of two upcoming changes.

Apple Cash will shortly require users to verify their identity before adding funds, and may enable the 'externally initiated funds transfer' feature.

If you use Apple Cash, you may have just received or will soon receive an email informing you of changes to the service's terms and conditions.

Apple partners with Green Dot Bank to provide Apple Cash, and the bank's updated terms page (view here) contains several important changes that Apple specifically highlighted in the email.

The only other change mentioned by Apple in the email concerns the arbitration section of Green Dot's terms. Apple has not listed the specific updates, but advises users to read the relevant changes carefully, as they affect users' rights and dispute resolution procedures.

Have you noticed any other changes to the updated Apple Cash terms? Let us know in the comments.
